resources.string: Recordings made with the recording line are kept only on this phone. The server deletes its copy within an hour after your phone saved it, and after 24 hours at the latest.
No recordings yet. During a call, tap Record.
Write down new recordings on OpenCaller\'s server (self-hosted speech recognition; the audio goes nowhere else). Off by default.
It is deleted from this phone and, if it is still there, from the server. This can\'t be undone.
Sign in to fetch recordings from the server.
The server couldn\'t be reached. Saved recordings still play.
The recording couldn\'t be saved on this phone.
